## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD Normal - <70% enzyme activity** | PQ 1 mg/kg/day over 7 days or TQ | N/A |
| **G6PD Normal - <30% enzyme activity** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days | Not specified |
| **G6PD Deficient - MildModerate** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Close medical supervision |
| **If no testing available** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Not specified |
